pnpm.//onlyBuiltDependencies: better-sqlite3 is deliberately absent. It has a binding.gyp but no install script, so allowlisting it makes pnpm default to `node-gyp rebuild` — which compiles from source and needs a full toolchain (this is what broke the Windows CI runner: no Visual Studio). It ships N-API prebuilds for darwin/linux/win32 x64+arm64, and N-API is ABI-stable across both Node and Electron, so the prebuild is all we need. Verified: with every compiled artifact deleted, the Electron app boots and runs its migrations on the prebuild alone.
pnpm.//overrides: Both force patched versions of transitive devDependencies that Dependabot cannot bump itself. minimatch: every 7.x-11.0.0 is open to GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 (DoS via globparts amplification) and 11.0.1 is the only fix, but eslint, @eslint/config-array, @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree, app-builder-lib (electron-builder) and @electron/universal still ask for minimatch ^10 or ^9 (3.x and 5.x are not affected and are left alone); remove this override once eslint, typescript-eslint and electron-builder ask for minimatch ^11 themselves. esbuild: drizzle-kit 0.31.x pulls in @esbuild-kit/esm-loader -> @esbuild-kit/core-utils, which pins esbuild ~0.18.20, open to GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99 (dev server answers cross-origin requests; fixed in 0.25.0); remove this override once drizzle-kit no longer depends on @esbuild-kit.
